summary: Marla Luckey, 31, set out on a run up the Red Creek Trail off Missionary Ridge around 11 a.m. Monday and failed to return; La Plata County Search & Rescue searched through the night across four trails; a dog-walker heard her calls for help ~12:30 p.m. Tuesday near Colvig Silver Camp; she was located shortly before 1 p.m. and walked down to her car, uninjured (basic running clothes, overnight temps in the 30s).
location: Red Creek Trail off Missionary Ridge / near Colvig Silver Camp
notes: SNIPPET-SOURCED: archives.durangotelegraph.com page returns a ColdFusion stack-trace error on open (site-side, 7th failed check across runs 199/232/274/372/424/473/527); facts from the search-indexed full text of the May-31-2012 'Quick and Dirty' issue ('Runner found after night outside'); date corroborated by weekday check (2012-05-28 was Monday); full-page verification pending.
